dct_description_sm: see also later version Lower Similkameen Band Chopaka 7 and 8 Reserves, 1902_2023 (https://doi.org/10.5683/SP3/6Q7EIA)

Georeferenced map of Lower Similkameen Band Chopaka 7 and 8 Reserves along the Similkameen River just north of the border with the United States of America. Land cover and features includes fields, huts, roads, villages and the types of land and soil.
